services.name: All Boat Tours
services.desc: The Key Largo Princess, a luxurious 75-foot glass-bottom aluminum motor yacht, is available for private charters and makes the perfect venue for private cocktail cruises, weddings, or group events. If you’re looking for a glass bottom boat Key Largo experience, our public sightseeing cruises offer an unforgettable way to explore the Florida Keys. The boat has a capacity of 140 people and can be chartered for a minimum of two hours, then in one-hour increments after. Guests can choose a daytime trip and either relax on our sun deck as they sip a tropical cocktail or beverage from our full service bar or ride in the comfort of our climate-controlled main cabin. blurb: Guests board the M. V. Key Largo Princess, a 75-foot luxury glass bottom boat, for a two-hour daily tour through John Pennekamp Coral Reef State Park and Key Largo National Marine Sanctuary. They can relax in an air-conditioned cabin with large viewing windows or on the sun deck while observing the underwater world. A full-service snack bar is available on board.
